payout_quote: To earn the $400.00 account bonus deposit, you must open a new personal checking account online or at any of our branches, provide the promo code "HOLYOKE" and set up and receive Qualifying Checking Account Direct Deposits totaling $1,500.00 or more within 90 calendar days of account opening.
steps: Open a new Florence Bank personal checking account online or at any branch with promo code HOLYOKE (new checking customers only; $10 minimum deposit).

Within 90 calendar days of opening, set up and receive qualifying direct deposits (regular ACH payroll, salary, pension, or government payments — not RTP, PayPal, Zelle, or Venmo) totaling $1,500 or more.
The $400 bonus is posted to the account within 14 business days after the 90-day qualifying period.
catches: New personal checking customers only: no existing Florence Bank checking relationship of any kind, and no checking closed within the last 180 days; employees excluded; one per customer.
Promo code HOLYOKE must be provided at account opening; account can be opened online or at any branch with a $10 minimum deposit.
Qualifying direct deposits = regular periodic ACH credits (payroll, salary, pension, government); RTP, PayPal, Zelle, Venmo and other P2P do not qualify.
$400 bonus posted within 14 business days after the 90-day qualifying period; bonus is income, reported on IRS Form 1099-INT.
Available as of July 6, 2026; limited-time offer that may be withdrawn at any time (no fixed end date).
biggest_catch: $1,500 in qualifying ACH direct deposits within 90 days — and only brand-new Florence Bank checking customers qualify (no checking relationship in the last 180 days).
